A Quarto 2 document of the project, as `report.qmd` is a Quarto 1 one. Its cells take run arrows,
as a script's statements do, and the arrow on line 1 previews the document.

## Origins

::: {.callout-note}
The heavy cars of each origin, from `data/summaries.av.sql`, in @fig-origins.
:::

```{avenger-sql}
#| label: fig-origins
#| fig-cap: Heavy cars by origin
FROM heavy_by_origin
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => Origin, y => cars) AS chart
```

## Cars

The horsepower and the fuel economy of each car, by origin, in @fig-cars. Drag to pan, scroll to
zoom, and hover a car for its values.

```{avenger-sql}
#| label: fig-cars
#| fig-cap: Horsepower and fuel economy
FROM vega_datasets.cars
|> AGGREGATE mark_symbol(x => Horsepower, y => Miles_per_Gallon, color => Origin, tools => [navigate(), tooltip()]) AS chart
```

## Weather

The wet days of each weather, then their chart. A day is wet when its precipitation is above zero.

```{avenger-sql}
FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE COUNT(*) AS days GROUP BY weather;

FROM wet_days
|> AGGREGATE mark_bar(x => weather, y => COUNT(*), title => title('Wet days', syntax => 'plain_lines')) AS chart
```
